about: File sharing from the command line.

prs.title: Encrypted uploads keep the whole file
prs.broken: With server-side encryption on, any file over about 4 KB was stored as a tiny stub, and the download failed, so the file was lost.
prs.changed: The encryption step now reads the whole file before closing, and tests cover several read sizes.
prs.matters: Encrypted uploads can be downloaded again intact.
